data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even all 25 leave 50, but recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Other catches require recalculation; intentions aren't binding. Each of you: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others? Willing fishers can opt in independently.
